'''Dahgee''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where unique [[Dahgee Lightsaber crystal|lightsaber crystals]] were [[Mining/Legends|mined]]. A small [[Dahgee Jedi|group]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with unique [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] also lived there. The [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] on Dahgee gave their [[Dahgee Jedi Lightsaber|lightsabers]] a strange, zigzagging blade with a black core, almost like a tree branch.
